prompt: Write the body (about 120 words) of a letter of representation from a personal injury lawyer to an auto insurer. The client was hurt in a hit while turning left. Ask that all contact go through the law firm, ask for the policy limits, and ask the insurer to keep all evidence. No salutation, no signature, no names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1052; do not mention it.)
text:
This firm has been retained to represent our client in connection with a motor vehicle collision that occurred when the at-fault vehicle struck our client's vehicle while our client was turning left. Our client sustained injuries as a result of this collision and is currently receiving treatment.

Please direct all further communication regarding this matter to our office and do not contact our client directly. Any statements, requests, or correspondence should be sent only to this firm.

We request that you provide the bodily injury liability policy limits applicable to your insured, along with a copy of the declarations page and confirmation of any other available coverage.

We also ask that your company preserve all evidence relating to this incident, including photographs, vehicle data, telematics information, dash camera footage, recorded statements, claim file materials, and any repair or inspection records. Failure to preserve such evidence may result in sanctions in any subsequent litigation.
